facts.label: Location
facts.value: Davis Road & Snake Road, Limestone County, Alabama

facts.label: Waterfront
facts.value: More than one mile along the Tennessee River's Wheeler Lake, east of the Elk River confluence; portions are direct waterfront, and portions border narrow TVA buffer zones

facts.label: Coves
facts.value: One is possibly suitable for a marina development

facts.label: Drive times
facts.value: About 15 minutes to Athens and 25 minutes to Huntsville

facts.label: Current use
facts.value: Row crop farming, currently soybeans and corn, and mature hardwood forest; farmed by one family for almost 80 years

facts.label: Concept
facts.value: Homesites from townhomes to estate lots, a possible community marina, trails, and open space

facts.label: Shoreline
facts.value: Wheeler Lake is a TVA reservoir; all docks, marinas, and other shoreline structures require TVA Section 26a approval

disclaimer: Sadler Farms represents a potential development opportunity. All plans, layouts, uses and renderings are conceptual and illustrative only, are not engineered, and are subject to planning, engineering, governmental approvals and permitting. Acreage, shoreline length and travel times are approximate and should be independently verified.
